It added so much character to the space.” — Reviewer from export FAQs Ask Away. We've Heard it All. Can GenStone panels be installed over drywall? Yes. GenStone panels can typically be installed directly over drywall for interior projects as long as the wall structure is sound. Panels are attached to wall studs or other secure mounting points. Brian Cassel Senior Project Coordinator How long does a typical GenStone project take? Most GenStone projects can be completed in a single afternoon or weekend depending on the size of the space. Because the panels are lightweight and designed to interlock, homeowners can install them much faster than traditional masonry stone. Courtney Mintz Project Coordinator Do I need special tools to install GenStone panels? No special masonry tools are required. Most projects can be completed using common tools like a circular saw, screws, a drill, and a level. The panels are easy to cut and install using standard woodworking tools. Kevin O'Dwyer General Manager Can I install GenStone panels myself? Yes. GenStone panels are specifically designed for DIY installation. Many homeowners complete projects like accent walls, fireplaces, and garage facades without hiring a contractor.
